ELECTRICITY — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Introduction to Electricity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Electricity.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Electricity.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Electricity.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Electricity.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
